Sidelong Reach.name: Sidelong Reach
Sidelong Reach.description: The user opens a pair of hand-sized gates, one at their side and one beside a target within a few strides, and reaches through. They can land a blow from behind or around a shield, dealing bludgeoning damage, or snatch a weapon, phone or key from the target's hand or belt; a target who did not see the gate open cannot block or dodge it. Strain: light.
